verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same. In both, the green circle has moved behind the SOLSTICE wordmark and the can, so the wordmark no longer sits on clean space as it did in the original. The peach circle also runs behind the start of the subhead and the left side of the CTA. A crowds the headline, subhead and CTA into a tight group and leaves about 140px of empty space below the CTA, so it looks top-heavy. B spreads the headline, subhead and CTA out more evenly down the canvas, which balances the layout slightly better, though its bottom area is still fairly empty.
